notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content:
- Added an end game panel to the scenario mode which shows some data such as how many resources you collected, produced etc...
- Handled a potential crash when clicking on the drone building

notes.title: First patch!
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for playing our game! After some feedback we've received, we're rolling out the first patch. It's quite minor, but all issues that were reported to us were fixed - so if there's anything else that slipped through our testing, please let us know!

Also please consider reviewing the game on the store - be it in a positive or negative light, reviews are important both for us, for Steam, and for other potential customers :)

[list]
[*] Fixed some event text displaying code instead of sprites
[*] Fixed rogue pixel bar in the main menu
[*] Fixed events on some resolutions
[*] Fixed collider size for the drone station (was slightly too big) 
[*] Somewhat improved next-turn resource predictions
[*] Fixed some resources in campaign floating slightly above the ground, meaning you could build over them
[/list]

All best and happy building!
Ziggy

notes.title: Citizens on Mars is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44024880/b26b7e619f6db1d40966d5ea854be7c2bc663bd4.png[/img]

[b]🚀🌌 Welcome to Mars, Citizens! 🌌🚀[/b]

We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest game, Citizens on Mars! Get ready for an incredible adventure in the cosmic world, where you decide the future of the planet Mars.

[b]🌠 Why you should give "Citizens on Mars" a try: 🌠[/b]

[i]🛰️ Build your cosmic empire:[/i] Start from scratch and create a functioning colony on the Red Planet. Open new frontiers, uncover the secrets of Mars, and shape it according to your dreams.

[i]🚀 Explore the unknown: [/i]Discover the mysteries of Mars by exploring its surface, and perhaps find something that will change the destiny of humanity.

[i]🤝 Cooperation and competition:[/i] Collaborate with other players in colony building or compete with them to prove who is the greatest leader on Mars.

[i]🌐 Dynamic world: [/i]See how your efforts impact the ever-changing landscape of Mars and its society.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2310630/Citizens_On_Mars/

[b]🌟 Share your reviews! 🌟[/b]

We encourage you to play "Citizens on Mars" and share your thoughts in the form of reviews on Steam. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and will help us strive for an even better gaming experience.

[b]🚀 Start your Martian adventure now! 🚀[/b]

Thank you for being with us on this cosmic journey. Together, we can conquer Mars and make it a second home for humanity!

notes.title: 🚀 SAVE THE DATE! 🚀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44024880/cb7572ca40042004f23c8fd39fc89f5ebf25c408.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, Martian Pioneers![/b]

[h3]We're thrilled to announce that the long-awaited premiere of [b]"Citizens: on Mars"[/b] is just around the corner, scheduled for October 25th. Get ready to embark on an extraordinary adventure, unlike any other.[/h3]

[b]🪐 Explore the Mysteries of Mars[/b]
Unearth the secrets hidden within the Red Planet's enigmatic landscapes. Venture into uncharted territory, and shape the future of humanity on this fascinating world.

[b]🛰 Develop and Thrive[/b]
Engage in scientific research and cutting-edge technology to ensure your survival on this alien terrain. Establish and expand your colonies, building impressive bases and cities.

[b]💫 Forge a Community[/b]
Create a thriving community where every citizen can find their place. Together, you'll overcome challenges, discover the unknown, and build a brighter future on Mars.

[b]📅 Save the Date![/b]
Mark your calendars for October 25th, and prepare for an epic journey beyond the stars. The fate of humanity rests in your hands!

For more information and to add [b]"Citizens: on Mars"[/b] to your wishlist, visit our Steam page  🎮
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2310630/Citizens_On_Mars/

Stay tuned for further updates and exciting reveals as we approach the release date. Join us in the quest to explore the Red Planet and make history together!

See you on Mars, fellow pioneers! 🌌
